sources.scope: Six original analytic hypotheses and literal stopped iid exponential-clock recursion unchanged. Every deterministic depth n, all abstract histories and rank-zero E included. A jointly Borel append preserves every old record and appends actual cumulative time/post-bounce state on the strict finite event B={0<W_n<d(H_n)}. Fixed Borel finite-valued d may be unbounded across histories; all jointly Borel extended nonnegative tests and null old-history events included without normalization or integrability/positive-mass premises. Negative-time/stopped append branches are auxiliary totalizations only. Joint and marginal n+1-history laws are restricted to B, never unrestricted laws or finite-wait guarantees. Only one actual history-extension edge within S87-I5/G86-11 closes if proved. Ordered absolute-time iteration, final survival/path assembly, full A7/global G86-11, physical-time residual memorylessness/random-depth restart/Markovness, invariance/nonexplosion/hypocoercivity/implementation errors/unbounded costs/main/composition/wholepaper/Goal remain OPEN. assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel structure, including rank zero; V:E→ℝ is C².
The six original analytic hypotheses are α>0, α≤β, V∈C², α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v, η>0 and βη≤1, with α,β≥0.
y,r,z₀ and deterministic depth n are universally quantified. The actual stopped recursion and raw iid Exp1 product P are literal definitions.

d:Hist_n→NNReal is any fixed Borel finite-valued cutoff, possibly unbounded across histories; F:Hist_(n+1)×ℝ→ENNReal is any jointly Borel test, and A is any Borel old-history event, including null events.
Every history/append/lift measurability fact, actual guarded constructor identity and transported law is a conclusion, not an input premise. The strict finite guard is never normalized.
units.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 let Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)), H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n), and μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Define W(live(T,z),e)=τ_z(max(e,0)), W(stopped,e)=0 and t(r,e)=real(untopD_0 W(r,e)). Define ρ(live(T,z),s)=ofReal[λ_r(Φ_s z)exp(−Λ_z(max(s,0)))] and ρ(stopped,s)=0. Write A_n(h,s) for the complete history obtained by preserving every old coordinate h_j and appending live(T+max(s,0),S_rΦ_s z) when h_n=live(T,z), and appending stopped when h_n=stopped. Put L_n(h,s)=(A_n(h,s),s). Negative real times use the displayed raw-real harmonic flow with a clipped cumulative increment; this and the stopped branch are auxiliary totalizations, with actual positive finite jump identification only on the guard below. H_(n+1), A_n and L_n are Borel, and A_n(h,s)_j=h_j for every old index0≤j≤n and every abstract(h,s). For every fixed Borel d:Hist_n→[0,∞), each value finite but with no uniform bound, define D_d(h,s)=1_{0<s<d(h)}ρ(h_n,s), B_d={w:0<W(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)<d(H_n(w))}, X_n(w)=(H_n(w),t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)), Y_n(w)=(H_(n+1)(w),t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)) and ν_d=D_d(μ_n⊗real Lebesgue). B_d and Y_n are Borel. For every w∈B_d, H_(n+1)(w)=A_n(X_n(w)), preserving the actual old records and appending exactly the actual cumulative next time and post-bounce state. The actual restricted laws satisfy (Y_n)_*(P|B_d)=(L_n)_*ν_d and (H_(n+1))_*(P|B_d)=(A_n)_*ν_d, and ((L_n)_*ν_d)(Hist_(n+1)×ℝ)≤1. These are restricted finite-component laws; no unrestricted next-history law is asserted. For every jointly Borel F:Hist_(n+1)×ℝ→[0,∞], the function h↦∫_ℝF(L_n(h,s))D_d(h,s)ds is Borel. For every Borel A⊆Hist_n, ∫_{B_d∩{H_n∈A}}F(Y_n(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫_ℝF(L_n(h,s))D_d(h,s)ds]μ_n(dh). No boundedness/integrability hypothesis on F, positive μ_n(A), normalized conditioning, constructor-law or measurability provider is assumed. The cases n=0, d=0, null A, stopped/infinite waits, zero hazard/normal, rank zero and unrealizable histories are included; infinite waits and zero/cutoff endpoints fail the strict guard, without an atom-equivalence assertion. This is attributed ASTIS completion of one actual complete-history extension ingredient implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7), using the already verified conditional finite-density law. Ordered absolute-time iteration, final survival/path-factor assembly, full(A.7), physical-time residual restart/Markovness, global conclusions, implementation/error/unbounded cost/main/composition/wholepaper/Goal remain OPEN. Survival88 and a separate no-atom theorem are not proof prerequisites.

steps.title: Keep the actual model and complete next history
steps.text: Retain all14 literal model/input/observer definitions. Consume the verified conditional density law, finite-history Borel law and actual harmonic flow/reflection producers under the same six source hypotheses. Fix n,y,r,z₀. Define the old and next complete histories, append A_n and paired lift L_n. The append uses Fin.snoc, so it retains every earlier record; its last entry is the literal cumulative-time and reflected-flow update. Its negative-time and stopped branches are declared auxiliary totalizations, not positive finite jump laws.
steps.lean:
classical
  let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
  let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
    (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
        (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
     (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
  let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
    (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
      ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
    Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
  let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
    MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
      (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
        Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
      (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
  let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
    match r with
    | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
    | Sum.inl a =>
      if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
        Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
          S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
  let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
    Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
  let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
  let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun w k => Real.toNNReal (w k)
  let history : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) →
      (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) :=
    fun y xRef z₀ n w j => record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j.val
  let waitObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
    fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
      | Sum.inl a => τ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)
      | Sum.inr _ => 0
  let timeObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ :=
    fun y xRef q => ((waitObs y xRef q).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0)
  let density : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞ :=
    fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
      | Sum.inl a => ENNReal.ofReal (rate xRef (Φ y xRef q.2 a.2) *
          Real.exp (-Λ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)))
      | Sum.inr _ => 0
  change
    ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ n : ℕ,
      let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
      let Hist := Fin (n + 1) → Rec
      let HistNext := Fin (n + 2) → Rec
      let last : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩
      let H : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist := history y xRef z₀ n
      let Hnext : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext := history y xRef z₀ (n + 1)
      let append : Hist × ℝ → HistNext := fun p =>
        Fin.snoc p.1 (match p.1 last with
          | Sum.inl a => Sum.inl (a.1 + Real.toNNReal p.2,
              S xRef (Φ y xRef p.2 a.2))
          | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ())
      let lift : Hist × ℝ → HistNext × ℝ := fun p => (append p, p.2)
      Measurable Hnext ∧ Measurable append ∧ Measurable lift ∧
      (∀ p : Hist × ℝ, ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), append p j.castSucc = p.1 j) ∧
      (∀ d : Hist → ℝ≥0, Measurable d →
        let μ : Measure Hist := Measure.map H P
        let D : Hist → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun h s =>
          if 0 < s ∧ s < (d h : ℝ) then density y xRef (h last, s) else 0
        let B : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {w |
          (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) ∧
          waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) <
            ((d (H w) : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0)}
        let X : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist × ℝ := fun w =>
          (H w, timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n))
        let Y : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext × ℝ := fun w =>
          (Hnext w, timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n))
        let ν : Measure (Hist × ℝ) := (μ.prod (volume : Measure ℝ)).withDensity
          (fun p => D p.1 p.2)
        MeasurableSet B ∧ Measurable Y ∧
        (∀ w ∈ B, Hnext w = append (X w)) ∧
        Measure.map Y (P.restrict B) = Measure.map lift ν ∧
        Measure.map Hnext (P.restrict B) = Measure.map append ν ∧
        (Measure.map lift ν) Set.univ ≤ 1 ∧
        (∀ F : HistNext × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F →
          Measurable (fun h => ∫⁻ s : ℝ, F (lift (h, s)) * D h s) ∧
          (∀ A : Set Hist, MeasurableSet A →
            (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, F (Y w) ∂P) =
              ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ s : ℝ, F (lift (h, s)) * D h s) ∂μ)))
  have hdensity := ActualConditionalNextWaitDensity.actual_conditional_next_wait_density
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hhistory := ActualFiniteHistoryTailLaw.actual_finite_history_tail_law
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hflow := ActualHarmonicFlow.actual_harmonic_flow_laws hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hbounce := ActualBounceRate.actual_bounce_rate_energy_laws hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  intro y xRef z₀ n
  let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
  let Hist := Fin (n + 1) → Rec
  let HistNext := Fin (n + 2) → Rec
  let last : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩
  let H : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist := history y xRef z₀ n
  let Hnext : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext := history y xRef z₀ (n + 1)
  let append : Hist × ℝ → HistNext := fun p =>
    Fin.snoc p.1 (match p.1 last with
      | Sum.inl a => Sum.inl (a.1 + Real.toNNReal p.2,
          S xRef (Φ y xRef p.2 a.2))
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ())
  let lift : Hist × ℝ → HistNext × ℝ := fun p => (append p, p.2)
  change Measurable Hnext ∧ Measurable append ∧ Measurable lift ∧
    (∀ p : Hist × ℝ, ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), append p j.castSucc = p.1 j) ∧ _

steps.title: Prove the complete append and next history are Borel
steps.text: The verified actual-history theorem at n+1 gives Borel H_(n+1), including the integrated-hazard/threshold-crossing/finite-recursion ingredients already proved there. For the append update, distribute the live/stopped record sum over real time. On live records the actual harmonic flow is jointly continuous/Borel and the zero-safe reflection is Borel; adding max(s,0) to the cumulative time is Borel. The stopped branch is constant. For every next-history coordinate, split into the new last entry and an old castSucc entry. These are respectively the Borel update and an old-history projection, proving Borel A_n. Pairing with s gives Borel L_n. Fin.snoc_castSucc proves exact preservation of every old entry for all abstract histories and real times.
steps.formula: H_{n+1},\ A_n,\ L_n\ \text{are Borel};\qquad A_n(h,s)_j=h_j\quad(0\le j\le n).
steps.lean:
-- Borel actual histories and the source's zero-safe flow/reflection constructor.
  have hH : Measurable H := (hhistory y xRef z₀ n).1
  have hHnext : Measurable Hnext := (hhistory y xRef z₀ (n + 1)).1
  let update : Rec × ℝ → Rec := fun q => match q.1 with
    | Sum.inl a => Sum.inl (a.1 + Real.toNNReal q.2, S xRef (Φ y xRef q.2 a.2))
    | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
  have hupdate : Measurable update := by
    let e := MeasurableEquiv.sumProdDistrib (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) Unit ℝ
    have hφ : Measurable (fun q : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ => Φ y xRef q.2 q.1.2) :=
      hflow.1.measurable.comp (f := fun q : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ =>
        ((y, xRef), q.2, q.1.2))
        (measurable_const.prodMk (measurable_snd.prodMk measurable_fst.snd))
    have hS : Measurable (fun q : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ =>
        S xRef (Φ y xRef q.2 q.1.2)) :=
      hbounce.1.comp ((measurable_const : Measurable
        (fun _ : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ => xRef)).prodMk hφ)
    have hl : Measurable (fun q : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ =>
        (Sum.inl (q.1.1 + Real.toNNReal q.2, S xRef (Φ y xRef q.2 q.1.2)) : Rec)) :=
      measurable_inl.comp ((measurable_fst.fst.add
        (measurable_real_toNNReal.comp measurable_snd)).prodMk hS)
    have heq : update = (Sum.elim
        (fun q : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ =>
          (Sum.inl (q.1.1 + Real.toNNReal q.2, S xRef (Φ y xRef q.2 q.1.2)) : Rec))
        (fun _ : Unit × ℝ => (Sum.inr () : Rec))) ∘ e := by
      funext q
      rcases q with ⟨a | a, s⟩ <;> rfl
    rw [heq]
    exact (hl.sumElim (measurable_const : Measurable
      (fun _ : Unit × ℝ => (Sum.inr () : Rec)))).comp e.measurable
  have hnew : Measurable (fun p : Hist × ℝ => update (p.1 last, p.2)) :=
    hupdate.comp (((measurable_pi_apply last).comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have happend : Measurable append := by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
    · simpa only [append, Fin.snoc_last] using hnew
    · simpa only [append, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Function.comp_def] using
        ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp (measurable_fst : Measurable (fun p : Hist × ℝ => p.1)))
  have hlift : Measurable lift := happend.prodMk measurable_snd
  have hprefix (p : Hist × ℝ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : append p j.castSucc = p.1 j := by
    simp only [append, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  refine ⟨hHnext, happend, hlift, hprefix, ?_⟩

steps.title: Reuse the exact strict finite-density component
steps.text: Fix any Borel finite-valued d, with no uniform bound. Define μ_n,D_d,B_d,X_n,Y_n and ν_d literally. Producer89 supplies Borel B_d and X_n, the exact restricted law (X_n)_*(P|B_d)=ν_d, ν_d mass≤1, and all nonnegative joint tests on old histories. Combining Borel H_(n+1) with the real-time projection of X_n gives Borel Y_n. No density, independence, finite wait or measurability is introduced as a new premise.

steps.title: Identify the actual full recursion on the finite guard
steps.text: Take w∈B_d. If its current record is stopped then W_n=0 contradicts the positive guard. For a live record (T,z), τ_z(ε_n)=∞ contradicts the finite upper bound, so the actual next branch is live. Split the next finite history into its final index and the earlier indices. Earlier entries are unchanged by definition. At the final index, unfold Nat.rec once: the source next record is live(T+untopD₀τ,S_rΦ_(real untopD₀τ)z). The observed t_n is precisely real untopD₀τ and toNNReal(t_n)=untopD₀τ, so this equals the appended final record. Thus H_(n+1)=A_n∘X_n pointwise on B_d and Y_n=L_n∘X_n there. No endpoint-mass or restart argument is used.
steps.formula: w\in B_d\ \Longrightarrow\ H_{n+1}(w)=A_n(H_n(w),t_n(w)),\quad A_n(h,s)_j=h_j\ (0\le j\le n).
steps.lean:
-- The positive finite guard identifies the source recursion pointwise.
  have hactual (w : ℕ → ℝ) (hw : w ∈ B) : Hnext w = append (X w) := by
    rcases hrec : record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n with a | a
    · have hfinite : τ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal (w n)) ≠ ⊤ := by
        intro ht
        have hupper := hw.2
        simp only [waitObs, hrec, ht] at hupper
        exact (not_lt_of_ge le_top) hupper
      funext j
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
      · simp only [append, Fin.snoc_last]
        change next y xRef (ε w n) (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n) = _
        simp [next, hrec, hfinite, H, history, last, X, timeObs, waitObs, ε]
      · simp only [append, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
        rfl
    · have hpositive := hw.1
      simp only [waitObs, hrec, lt_self_iff_false] at hpositive
  have hYactual (w : ℕ → ℝ) (hw : w ∈ B) : Y w = lift (X w) :=
    Prod.ext (hactual w hw) rfl

steps.title: Transport the actual joint law and its marginal
steps.text: Pointwise equality on the Borel event gives equality almost everywhere under P restricted to B_d. Replace Y_n by L_n∘X_n in its pushforward, compose measurable pushforwards, and use the exact89 joint law to obtain (L_n)_*ν_d. Apply the same argument directly to H_(n+1)=A_n∘X_n for the marginal. Since L_n is measurable, the total mass of its pushforward is exactly ν_d(univ), hence≤1 by89. This is a subprobability mass bound, without renormalizing missing mass or claiming an unrestricted next-history distribution.
steps.lean:
-- Compose the exact89 joint measure law; the event is never normalized.
  have hjoint : Measure.map Y (P.restrict B) = Measure.map lift ν := by
    rw [← hXlaw, Measure.map_map hlift hX]
    exact Measure.map_congr (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hB hYactual)
  have hmarginal : Measure.map Hnext (P.restrict B) = Measure.map append ν := by
    rw [← hXlaw, Measure.map_map happend hX]
    exact Measure.map_congr (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hB hactual)
  have hmass : (Measure.map lift ν) Set.univ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [Measure.map_apply hlift MeasurableSet.univ, Set.preimage_univ]
    exact hνmass
  refine ⟨hB, hY, hactual, hjoint, hmarginal, hmass, ?_⟩

steps.title: Integrate every joint test on every old-history event
steps.text: For jointly Borel ENNReal F on the extended history and relative time, F∘L_n is a jointly Borel test admitted by89. Its parameter integral is Borel, even when infinite. For any Borel old-history A, use the pointwise Y_n=L_n(X_n) identity throughout B_d∩{H_n∈A} to replace the actual integrand. Producer89 then gives the displayed unnormalized iterated integral. Null A, unbounded F and unbounded finite-valued d require no additional premise. The result closes one actual next-history extension step; ordered absolute-time iteration and the terminal survival factor remain separate.
steps.lean:
-- All joint ENNReal tests, including infinity and null old-history events.
  intro F hF
  have htest := htests (F ∘ lift) (hF.comp hlift)
  refine ⟨htest.1, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  calc
    (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, F (Y w) ∂P) =
        ∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, (F ∘ lift) (X w) ∂P := by
      apply setLIntegral_congr_fun (hB.inter (hA.preimage hH))
      intro w hw
      exact congrArg F (hYactual w hw.1)
    _ = ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ s : ℝ, F (lift (h, s)) * D h s) ∂μ := htest.2 A hA

units.lean_statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 let Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)), H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n), and μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Define W(live(T,z),e)=τ_z(max(e,0)), W(stopped,e)=0 and t(r,e)=real(untopD_0 W(r,e)). Define ρ(live(T,z),s)=ofReal[λ_r(Φ_s z)exp(−Λ_z(max(s,0)))] and ρ(stopped,s)=0. Write A_n(h,s) for the complete history obtained by preserving every old coordinate h_j and appending live(T+max(s,0),S_rΦ_s z) when h_n=live(T,z), and appending stopped when h_n=stopped. Put L_n(h,s)=(A_n(h,s),s). Negative real times use the displayed raw-real harmonic flow with a clipped cumulative increment; this and the stopped branch are auxiliary totalizations, with actual positive finite jump identification only on the guard below. H_(n+1), A_n and L_n are Borel, and A_n(h,s)_j=h_j for every old index0≤j≤n and every abstract(h,s). For every fixed Borel d:Hist_n→[0,∞), each value finite but with no uniform bound, define D_d(h,s)=1_{0<s<d(h)}ρ(h_n,s), B_d={w:0<W(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)<d(H_n(w))}, X_n(w)=(H_n(w),t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)), Y_n(w)=(H_(n+1)(w),t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)) and ν_d=D_d(μ_n⊗real Lebesgue). B_d and Y_n are Borel. For every w∈B_d, H_(n+1)(w)=A_n(X_n(w)), preserving the actual old records and appending exactly the actual cumulative next time and post-bounce state. The actual restricted laws satisfy (Y_n)_*(P|B_d)=(L_n)_*ν_d and (H_(n+1))_*(P|B_d)=(A_n)_*ν_d, and ((L_n)_*ν_d)(Hist_(n+1)×ℝ)≤1. These are restricted finite-component laws; no unrestricted next-history law is asserted. For every jointly Borel F:Hist_(n+1)×ℝ→[0,∞], the function h↦∫_ℝF(L_n(h,s))D_d(h,s)ds is Borel. For every Borel A⊆Hist_n, ∫_{B_d∩{H_n∈A}}F(Y_n(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫_ℝF(L_n(h,s))D_d(h,s)ds]μ_n(dh). No boundedness/integrability hypothesis on F, positive μ_n(A), normalized conditioning, constructor-law or measurability provider is assumed. The cases n=0, d=0, null A, stopped/infinite waits, zero hazard/normal, rank zero and unrealizable histories are included; infinite waits and zero/cutoff endpoints fail the strict guard, without an atom-equivalence assertion. This is attributed ASTIS completion of one actual complete-history extension ingredient implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7), using the already verified conditional finite-density law. Ordered absolute-time iteration, final survival/path-factor assembly, full(A.7), physical-time residual restart/Markovness, global conclusions, implementation/error/unbounded cost/main/composition/wholepaper/Goal remain OPEN. Survival88 and a separate no-atom theorem are not proof prerequisites.
